mean_degree_ANCHOR.note: ANCHOR STATISTIC — kappa_share=0.01 was set to produce ⟨k⟩≈2.6. Reporting this as PASS is circular. ⟨k⟩ becomes a held-out check only after kappa_share is derived from behavioral rates independently. See params.py kappa_share and shared_fraction_per_partner.

giant_component.note: Buchanan 2019; Klovdahl/Potterat 1994. Not anchored by mean.

mean_path_length.note: Klovdahl/Potterat 1994. Not pinned by mean degree.

dispersion_k2_over_k2.target: > 1.0 (over-dispersed; real injection networks have heavy-tailed degree)
dispersion_k2_over_k2.note: HELD-OUT check. ⟨k²⟩/⟨k⟩² > 1 = over-dispersed. Rolls 2011, Buchanan 2019: empirical injection networks are over-dispersed. This is the τ_c-relevant statistic — NOT pinned by anchoring ⟨k⟩.

clustering_coefficient.note: Rolls 2011. Not anchored by mean. Useful for structural realism.

k2_tail.target: SENSITIVITY RANGE — not a pass/fail check
k2_tail.note: TAIL CAVEAT (mandatory): ⟨k²⟩ is the most under-captured quantity in all available empirical datasets. ⟨k²⟩ directly sets τ_c. See Stage 3 sweep for τ_c band.
